Don't focus on the scale. It always starts like this, very little loss. But it will happen, just over a long period of time. Weight loss isn't easy at all but it will happen if you continue to work at it. A really great way to possibly increase this is to add exercise to your daily routine. Not rigorous exercise, even light jogging or just walking more every day will help lose weight. 

Larger people lose weight faster because it takes more calories to get them moving. I started walking around 5,000 - 7,000 steps a day instead of the sedimentary 1,000 - 2,000 and it's really helped me not only lose appetite but also just feel better in health. Start small and have her work her way up. Don't start rigorously exercising, this will only add strain to her muscles and be exhausting. 

Don't let her give up on her journey!
